headings.usage: H1, H2, H3 - Use for elegant, cinematic storytelling

usage_rules.background: Deep Navy (#081A2C) as the primary base. NO pure black. Use Ocean Blue (#0F4C81) for subtle gradient glows.
usage_rules.text: Sand (#E8DCC2) for readable body text on dark backgrounds. White (#F9FAFB) for high-contrast headings.
usage_rules.accents: Gold (#D4AF37) for buttons, borders, stars, and active states.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: High-end crystal glass: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#081A2C]/60 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Subtle SVG grain overlay mixed with opacity 0.03 to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.wave_animation: Use SVG paths with Framer Motion or CSS keyframes to create a very slow, subtle, overlapping wave motion at the bottom of the hero section, glowing with Ocean Blue and Gold.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3) for elegant dividers. Avoid thick borders.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. This is critical for the premium 10k PLN feel. Wrap the app in a Lenis provider.
motion.hero_reveal: Signature SOTD masked line-by-line text reveal for 'Trio Molo Cafe' using framer-motion. overflow-hidden on parent, y: 100% -> 0 on child.
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform to move background images slower than foreground elements, especially in the Atmosphere section.
motion.stagger: List items (menu, gallery, info cards) must stagger in using framer-motion delayChildren and staggerChildren.

layouts.spacing: SOTD-level generous spacing. Sections must have py-24 or py-32. Don't cramp elements. Let the negative space breathe.
layouts.bento_info_bar: 4 overlapping glassmorphism cards at the bottom of the hero section, pulling the user into the scroll. Use grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4.
layouts.about_section: Asymmetric 2-column layout. Image takes 5/12, Text takes 7/12. Image should have a slight parallax offset.
layouts.masonry_gallery: Dynamic masonry grid, overlapping edges, 1px gold border on hover. Lightbox integration.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee passing behind or over the Atmosphere section with words like 'SUNSET • COCKTAILS • OCEAN BREEZE • PREMIUM ROAST'

components.Hero: Full viewport height. Background image with sunset/ocean, heavy vignette/overlay (bg-gradient-to-b from-[#081A2C]/30 via-transparent to-[#081A2C]). Kinetic typography. 2 minimalist buttons ('Zobacz menu' - Gold filled, 'Wyznacz trasę' - outline). Animated scroll arrow pointing down.
components.InfoBar: 4 cards: 'Molo Spacerowe Pokład Dolny', '4.1 1200+ opinii', '20-40 zł', 'Widok na morze'. Glassmorphism, overlapping hero bottom edge.
components.MenuPreview: Minimalist list. Items: Sex on the Beach 39zł, Ciasto dnia 23zł, Cappuccino 17zł, Aperol Spritz 35zł. Hovering over an item reveals its image floating nearby (cursor follow effect).
components.AtmosphereParallax: Panoramic ocean view, slow parallax, huge typography 'POCZUJ KLIMAT MOLO'.
components.AdminPanel: Clean, Shadcn-based dashboard. Tables for menu items, grid for gallery management. Use Sand/Navy theme but optimized for data density (smaller fonts, tighter padding).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Sand text against Deep Navy meets 4.5:1 ratio. Gold buttons need dark text for contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#D4AF37].
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid to all buttons, links, forms, and major sections.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You are building a premium 10,000 PLN Awwwards site. DO NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe templates.
Use JS/JSX files only. NO TypeScript (no .tsx).
DO NOT center align the entire App. Left-align text naturally, use deliberate asymmetry.
NEVER use generic placeholder images. Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs.
NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals over images. Always use the defined glassmorphism.
Ensure framer-motion and lenis work seamlessly. Prevent layout jumping by using proper CSS grid/flex wrappers around motion elements.
The CMS Admin Panel is required. It should manage the Menu and Gallery. Mock the backend APIs if necessary, but the UI must be fully functional.
Animations must be smooth and performant. Use transform and opacity exclusively for animations.
